notes.title: We've Added Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
Hey there! Shay here again with a quick FaceValue update, some patch notes, and a small teaser for our next project!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343704/d286e7b68f301fbdab2ced4de65d49a02034725d.png

First up, Steam Achievements!

Whilst we've been busy working away on our new project, we thought it would be nice to go back to FaceValue for the Summer Sale and tidy up a few bits and pieces, and add in achievements so that there is a little more value for anyone new who picks it up, or anyone that's already supported us.

Patch Notes


 Added Steam Integration and Achievements
 Added more detailed options menu
 Fixed custom cursor not displaying
 Fixed audio issues in Hub levels
 Fixed various visual glitches 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343704/384393d76c3b6d3dc52fb719c3544dafaeb48379.jpg

And now, I'd like you to meet "Agoh the Engineer"

The first character from our new game, who as you can probably guess, comes from the same world in which FaceValue is set.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343704/a2ea2d774bada2bfb0423a2e8d54398811896e56.png

He also seems pretty excited about the sale, judging by that cube!

We're excited to share more about our next project and the larger world that encompasses both it and FaceValue in the near future!

Thanks for reading!

Where to find us
Twitter : @SureWhyNotGames
Youtube : @SureWhyNotGames
Website : www.surewhynot.co.uk

notes.title: Audio Updates, Improvements & Fixes
notes.content:
Hey, Shay here again with some patch notes and a quick update on FaceValue and the studio moving forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343704/24d29d0bb18b8d8f864703496d57970b9ede4016.png

First up, patch notes:


New audio added for multiple interactions
Wall lowered throughout game for better readability
Various bug fixes


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43343704/2784dc2af50fcaee88a426378dbf0e70acc0933e.jpg

On to the future of Sure Why Not? and FaceValue. We still have plans for additional updates to FaceValue to add some extra details here and there, and possibly looking into a mobile port in the coming months. But we also just secured our next project, and are super excited to be able to share that with you soon!

For now, enjoy the improvements as we roll them out, and keep an eye here and on our social media for updates!
